qualifier: SREBP sterol control plus ATF6/CREB3 unfolded protein response
name: SREBP cholesterol and ATF6 unfolded-protein transcription
rationale: Members are SREBP-driven cholesterol homeostasis programmes and ATF6/CREB3 ER-stress transcription (both ER-anchored factors released by proteolysis); the ATF6/CREB3 arm is what all confusables lack.

core: Metabolic reprogramming of glycolysis under stress
name: HIF- and p53-driven glycolytic metabolic reprogramming
rationale: Members cover HIF oxygen sensing, glycolysis, pentose-phosphate and nucleotide catabolism regulation with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic control, distinguishing it from fermentation/lactate and NRF2-centred neighbours.

name: MHC class II peptide antigen processing and presentation
rationale: All members concern loading and regulation of exogenous peptide presentation on MHC class II, unlike confusables centred on MHC class I cross-presentation, lipid antigens or DC/monocyte surface signatures.

name: Chondrocyte and osteoblast-driven cartilage and bone formation
rationale: Members span cartilage development, chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation (RUNX2, BMP/Wnt), ossification and joint/tendon morphogenesis, whereas confusables emphasise osteoclast resorption, collagen secretion or cadherin regulation.

qualifier: connexon gap junctions and metabotropic glutamate input
name: Connexon gap junctions and neuronal calcium signaling
rationale: Members combine connexon assembly and gap-junction transmission with neuronal calcium entry, presynaptic and metabotropic glutamate signaling, separating it from pure gap-junction regulation or presynaptic GABA/kainate modulation themes.

qualifier: sodium/calcium exchange and voltage-gated channel activation
name: Cardiac calcium homeostasis via sodium/calcium exchange
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte calcium handling, membrane potential and lowering cytosolic calcium via Na/Ca exchangers, whereas confusables focus on SERCA/sarcoplasmic reticulum uptake and ryanodine release.

name: Melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis in pigmentation
rationale: Members cover melanin synthesis, MITF pigmentation genes, melanosome/dense granule assembly and light responses, unlike confusables on other MITF programmes, organelle acidification or lysosomal enzyme targeting.

qualifier: DNA topology and recombinational telomere maintenance
name: Replication stress, DNA topology and recombinational telomere maintenance
rationale: Members address fork reversal, topoisomerase-linked damage, R-loops and recombination/replication-based telomere maintenance, while confusables centre on telomere capping/NHEJ protection or checkpoint signaling.

name: Aspartate/glutamate transporter defects and aspartate uptake
rationale: Members are aspartate import and inherited defects of glutamate/aspartate transporters (EAAT and vesicular glutamate), distinct from confusables on GABA/glycine transport and astrocytic glutamate reuptake.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD(P) synthesis
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated acetyl-CoA formation, CoA biosynthesis and NAD/NADP salvage and regeneration, distinguishing it from TCA cycle, thiamine and lipoylation/OGDH confusables.

qualifier: Rab/Ras prenylation and Wnt ligand lipidation
name: Rab/Ras prenylation and Wnt ligand lipidation
rationale: Members concern geranylgeranylation of Rabs, Ras processing and PORCN-dependent Wnt lipidation and secretion, whereas confusables involve Hedgehog palmitoylation or phospholipid transfer.

name: Responses to organic toxicants, pesticides, ethanol and nicotine
rationale: Members are cellular responses to environmental organic chemicals (AhR/dioxin, pesticides, bisphenol, ethanol, nicotine, anesthetics), unlike confusables on metal ions, vitamins or anticancer drugs.

name: ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux and nascent HDL assembly
rationale: Members cover ABCA1/LXR-driven cholesterol and phospholipid efflux, apoA-I signaling and HDL assembly, while confusables emphasise HDL/LDL remodeling, clearance and cholesterol import.

core: Nuclear receptor transcriptional control of metabolism
name: LXR nuclear receptor regulation of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are LXR-regulated lipogenesis, gluconeogenesis and lipolysis genes plus nuclear receptor transcription and SUMOylation, distinct from lipid droplet, adipogenesis and PPARA/circadian confusables.

qualifier: zinc, copper, manganese transport and metallothionein detoxification
name: Zinc, copper and manganese homeostasis and heavy-metal detoxification
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc, copper and manganese transport, MTF1/metallothionein and cadmium detoxification, separating it from iron/heme and cobalt/lead/selenium response confusables.

qualifier: fat cell proliferation and PPAR signaling regulation
name: White adipose expansion and PPAR signaling control
rationale: Members regulate white fat cell proliferation, fat pad development, PPAR signaling and thermogenesis restraint, whereas confusables focus on brown/beige differentiation or white adipocyte differentiation and triglyceride handling.

name: Pulmonary surfactant and alveolar pneumocyte development
rationale: Members are surfactant metabolism and its inherited defects, type I/II pneumocyte differentiation, saccule development and perinatal hyperoxia/ductus closure, unlike lung branching, secretory cell or erythrocyte gas exchange confusables.

name: Acetylcholine, serotonin and adenosine receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover nicotinic and muscarinic cholinergic transmission, serotonin and adenosine receptors and their cAMP coupling, distinguishing it from tachykinin, adrenergic and histamine/serotonin-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: urea cycle and glutathione/sulfur amino acid metabolism
name: Amino acid catabolism, urea cycle and glutathione metabolism
rationale: Members span amino acid synthesis and catabolism, urea cycle disorders, glutathione and transsulfuration, BH4 and B6 cofactors, while confusables are selenium metabolism, malate-aspartate shuttle or gluconeogenesis.

name: Collagen receptor-driven platelet adhesion and aggregation
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion to collagen, GPVI and GPIb-IX-V signaling and aggregation control, unlike confusables on VWF defects/degranulation or ADP, thrombin and thromboxane GPCR signaling.

name: CYP2E1 oxidation and N-acetylation of aromatic drugs
rationale: Members are paracetamol metabolism via CYP2E1, acetylation and aromatic/nitrogen compound detoxification, differing from confusables on CYP1A2, glycine conjugation or methylation/sulfonation.

qualifier: NRF2 oxidative and HIF hypoxic programmes
name: NRF2 and HIF redox and hypoxia transcription
rationale: Members combine NRF2 regulation and target programmes with HIF oxygen sensing, glycolysis and BACH1 control, whereas confusables involve p53/mTORC1 metabolism, FOXO or ROS/ferroptosis.

core: Inner ear sensory hair cell biology
qualifier: hair cell differentiation and auditory/vestibular mechanosensation
name: Inner ear hair cell differentiation and mechanosensory function
rationale: Members cover hair cell fate, stereocilia, sound and gravity detection and vestibular reflexes, unlike confusables on gross ear morphogenesis or microvillus/brush border assembly.

qualifier: chemokine- and integrin-mediated T cell migration
name: Chemokine- and integrin-mediated T cell migration and homing
rationale: Members are chemokine-receptor signaling, integrin adhesion and T cell chemotaxis/homing, distinguished from monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1, lymphoid organ and B cell migration confusables.

name: Tubulin glutamylation and microtubule remodeling in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members cover tubulin polyglutamylation/deglutamylation, microtubule severing, kinesins and sperm mitochondrial sheath/Sertoli barrier formation, unlike ciliary axoneme or centrosome/spindle confusables.
